text:
maya: Nightly perf job OOMing on paged-attn with long inputs (~8k tokens). Root cause is not obvious — memory spikes then kernel fallback starts, followed by compaction churn. Attaching quick trace below.

sven: Can you paste the profiler snippet? curious if kernel selector is switching to the slow safe path or if workspace allocation is blowing up.

maya: profiler excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T04:12:38Z] step=1024 model=redwood-llm-v2
kernel_selector: chosen=attn_opt_v2 fallback=attn_safe_v1
kernel_latency_ms: opt=1.6 fallback=10.9
workspace_bytes_requested: opt=180MB fallback=1.1GB
kv_cache.size_bytes=4.2GB kv_cache.evictions=48
blockmgr.pages_active=1264 blockmgr.free_blocks=42 compaction_ops=14 compaction_cpu_ms=320
OOM at allocate(1.05GB) in workspace_reserve()
```

arjun: Looks like kernel_selector flips when per-step latency > ~2ms which forces huge fallback WS (1.1GB). That much fallback workspace plus KV cache >4GB pushes us over. Batching heuristic ramps concurrency too high during tail batches (we're hitting 48 concurrent inflight sequences).

liz: I repro locally with a synthetic 8k sequence. Two notes: lowering block_size from 1024->512 reduces compaction CPU by ~40% but increases total number of blocks and causes slightly higher fragmentation in the allocator. Also observed buffer reuse rate drops from 72%->56% because more smaller buffers are requested.

perf-bot: alloc_histogram:
```
0-64MB: 34%
64-256MB: 47%
256-1GB: 15%
>1GB: 4% (mostly fallback kernel)
reused_buffers_ratio=0.61
```

maya: Proposed mitigation plan (short-term):
- tune kernel_selector threshold for opt->fallback transition (raise threshold to avoid spurious flips for sub-threshold latency)
- limit per-worker concurrency when KV cache > 3.5GB (avoid oversubscribe)
- add a quick allocator patch to prefer reusing >256MB buffers for ephemeral workspaces (low-risk micro-optimization)

sven: Long-term I'd like:
- per-block reuse metric (hits / requests) + compaction CPU time in Dashboard
- smarter compaction policy: skip compaction if free_blocks < X or if compaction_cpu_ms/step > Y.

arjun: I'll draft the allocator PR to bias reuse and add an env flag `RW_HEAP_REUSE_THRESHOLD_MB` so we can ramp in canary. Will also add a guard to the batcher to cap concurrency when kv_cache_size large.

liz: Experiment note: when we disabled compaction for blocks < 512b the OOM didn't occur but fragmentation slowly increased over long runs. We need a safe background compaction cadence rather than aggressive synchronous compaction.

maya: Summary: small PRs inbound — allocator reuse + batcher cap + selector tweak. Canaries tonight on Dedicated1 (low-traffic). I'll open an issue for dashboard metrics so SRE can alert on compaction CPU regressions.

sven: SGTM. please include perf numbers in the PR description (before/after reuse ratio, compaction CPU). :thumbsup:

arjun: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/842 (draft)

maya: thanks — I'll run a 100-iteration stress after merge and post the profile.

liz: :thumbsup:
